ada.title: The last bowl
ada.prompt: Ada has one bowl of stew left. A courier is due late, but the child waiting at her table has already asked for seconds.

choices.label: Split the bowl now
choices.reply: Ada pours two smaller bowls and puts bread beside the first. She asks the child to help set out the second.

choices.label: Keep a bowl for the courier
choices.reply: Ada sets the lid back on. The child helps her write a note so the courier knows whose place was saved.

aya.title: A path through the reeds
aya.prompt: Aya finds fresh bootprints around the nesting bank. Someone has left stepping stones that lead straight past a nest.

choices.label: Mark a path around the nest
choices.reply: Aya uses the stones to mark a bend well away from the bank. By noon, the footprints follow it.

choices.label: Move the stones to the old path
choices.reply: Aya carries the first stone herself. At the old path she finds a smaller set of tracks following the boots.

bea.title: The ferry knot
bea.prompt: Bea is mending Hollis’s best net. A knot in the corner is strong enough, and it is the first one he taught her to tie.

choices.label: Keep the old knot
choices.reply: Bea mends around it. She pulls it once with both hands before putting the net down.

choices.label: Ask Hollis to show you the knot
choices.reply: Hollis ties it slowly enough for both of you to follow. Bea leaves him the last loose end.

bram.title: Two names, one sack
bram.prompt: Bram’s old tally lists one sack under Mara’s name. Two families remember dividing it on the bakery steps.

choices.label: Ask both families how to record it
choices.reply: Bram leaves space for both accounts. He uses the back of the page when the front runs out of room.

choices.label: Keep the tally and add a note
choices.reply: Bram copies the weight as written, then adds a note in his own hand about where the flour went.

cyrus.title: The chipped cup
cyrus.prompt: Cyrus has set out a chipped cup for a customer who has been gone for years. A new visitor reaches for it.

choices.label: Offer the cup to the visitor
choices.reply: Cyrus pours the tea. He sets out a second cup in case the old customer ever comes back.

choices.label: Ask about the old customer
choices.reply: Cyrus tells you her name, then asks the visitor which cup they would like to use.

del.title: First refusal
del.prompt: Del has one paid shift left on a repair crew. A former tenant wants the work, but the apprentice already brought tools.

choices.label: Ask the two workers to split the shift
choices.reply: Del goes to find a second hammer and pays both workers for the time they actually spend.

choices.label: Give the apprentice the booked shift
choices.reply: Del keeps his word to the apprentice and asks the former tenant which work they want first next week.

elias.title: The unnamed jar
elias.prompt: Elias finds a jar of seeds with only a water stain where the label should be. He thinks it came from a flooded garden.

choices.label: Save a row for the seeds
choices.reply: Elias marks the row as a trial and puts a clean envelope aside for the next harvest.

choices.label: Ask the former gardeners to identify them
choices.reply: Elias takes the jar down to the lane. Two people disagree about the variety and both offer to help grow it.

faye.title: The old hive stand
faye.prompt: Faye finds her old hive stand on land that changed hands after the flood. The new owner has repaired the legs.

choices.label: Ask whether the stand can be shared
choices.reply: Faye and the owner agree to talk before bringing bees back. She offers to show them how to check the shade.

choices.label: Set up a new stand together
choices.reply: Faye asks for help carrying two boards. She measures the site twice before choosing where the bees will go.

greta.title: The draft minutes
greta.prompt: Greta brings two drafts of the same meeting. One names her vote. The other says the decision was unanimous.

choices.label: Ask to keep both drafts together
choices.reply: Greta writes the date on both copies and adds her name to the one that left it out.

choices.label: Ask Greta to write her own account
choices.reply: Greta crosses out the first sentence twice. She starts again with where she was sitting when the vote was called.

hollis.title: An oar on the bank
hollis.prompt: Hollis carries an old oar to the landing and rests it against a post. He asks how far you think the water has moved.

choices.label: Walk the bank with him
choices.reply: Hollis stops at a flat stone and shows you where the ferry used to scrape bottom.

choices.label: Stay at the landing and listen
choices.reply: Hollis sits beside the oar. After a while he tells you the name of the first person he learned to ferry.

indigo.title: The road in pencil
indigo.prompt: Indigo has drawn the drowned road in pencil. A former resident has asked her to leave their house off the public map.

choices.label: Mark the road and keep the house private
choices.reply: Indigo inks the road. She puts the house on a separate sheet and asks where that sheet should be kept.

choices.label: Invite the resident to finish the map
choices.reply: Indigo hands them the pencil. They draw the bend before deciding whether to draw their home.

iona.title: The empty chair
iona.prompt: Iona sets out chairs for a small meeting. She has one invitation left and two people who have stopped coming.

choices.label: Ask who has been waiting longest
choices.reply: Iona checks her notes and goes to deliver the invitation in person.

choices.label: Find room for another chair
choices.reply: Iona takes a chair from behind her desk and puts both invitations in her coat pocket.

joel.title: A tree in the wrong pot
joel.prompt: A sapling Joel promised to a displaced family has outgrown its pot. Their new garden has room for a smaller tree.

choices.label: Offer the family a choice of trees
choices.reply: Joel brings two pots out into the light and lets the family see how each would grow.

choices.label: Find a temporary spot for the larger tree
choices.reply: Joel moves it into the nursery bed and leaves the name tag on until the family decides.

kit.title: The gate test
kit.prompt: Kit has built a model gate for the old field. The hinge works until a lamb leans on it.

choices.label: Help brace the hinge
choices.reply: Kit tries the brace with his elbow. He asks Willa to hold the other end while he tests it again.

choices.label: Ask Willa where the old gate stood
choices.reply: Willa shows Kit the worn patch by the path. He redraws the model before making another hinge.

lark.title: The branch across the line
lark.prompt: One of Lark’s apple branches reaches over a disputed garden boundary. The fruit is ready to pick.

choices.label: Invite the neighbor to share the harvest
choices.reply: Lark carries two baskets out. The neighbor starts on the low branch while Lark holds it steady.

choices.label: Ask where the next tree should go
choices.reply: Lark sets the ladder down and walks the boundary with the neighbor before making another planting mark.

mara.title: The oven goes cold
mara.prompt: Mara has enough fuel for one more batch. The bakery has paid orders waiting, and Ada needs bread for supper.

choices.label: Ask the customers to share the batch
choices.reply: Mara makes smaller loaves and explains the split to each customer as they arrive.

choices.label: Fill the paid orders and help Ada plan another meal
choices.reply: Mara finishes the orders. She gives Ada yesterday’s crusts to toast over the soup pot.

milo.title: Two rain readings
milo.prompt: Milo measured less rain by the market than Vera did downstream. A council note asks him to file just one figure.

choices.label: Post both readings with their locations
choices.reply: Milo puts both numbers on the board. A neighbor adds a third reading from farther downriver.

choices.label: Recheck the gauges with Vera
choices.reply: They find one gauge under a drip line. Milo keeps the old readings and marks what changed.

mina.title: A jar with a name
mina.prompt: Mina finds a jar marked for a customer who left after the flood. The customer has come back to visit family.

choices.label: Offer the jar unopened
choices.reply: Mina brings it out with the label still attached and lets the customer decide when to open it.

choices.label: Ask whether to open it together
choices.reply: Mina fetches two spoons. The customer reads the label aloud before she breaks the seal.

ness.title: The scrap bucket
ness.prompt: Ness finds clean vegetable scraps mixed with spoiled packing paper in the shared bucket. Nobody wants to claim the mistake.

choices.label: Sort the bucket with Ness
choices.reply: Ness works beside you and shows which scraps can still go into the heap.

choices.label: Put up a sorting example by the bucket
choices.reply: Ness sets out a small tray with examples. The next neighbor to arrive asks where to put their onion skins.

niko.title: The noticeboard in the rain
niko.prompt: Rain has worked behind the new noticeboard. Niko can hide the damage with paint or take the panel down to fix the seam.

choices.label: Help take the panel down
choices.reply: Niko sets the wet boards in the sun and asks Sol to check the seam before he hangs them again.

choices.label: Put up a temporary board together
choices.reply: Niko transfers every notice to a spare board first. The wet one can dry without making anyone miss a meeting.

opal.title: The wrong bell
opal.prompt: Opal tries a new storm signal. Otto recognizes it, but two people on the far bank think it means a gathering.

choices.label: Try a second signal with Otto’s lamp
choices.reply: Otto shields the flame and lifts it on the last ring. Both people on the far bank wave back.

choices.label: Ask the far bank to suggest a rhythm
choices.reply: Opal listens while someone taps three beats on the railing. She tries it back before writing it down.

orin.title: The key on the table
orin.prompt: Orin puts the old house key beside his copy of the deed. A neighbor has asked to display them together.

choices.label: Ask what he wants people to see
choices.reply: Orin says the deed can be read. He slips the key back into his pocket.

choices.label: Offer to help describe the key instead
choices.reply: Orin dictates two plain lines about the door it opened. He keeps the key in his hand while you write.

otto.title: A lamp for the bend
otto.prompt: Otto’s favorite lamp needs a new glass pane. A volunteer has come to learn the route and offers to take it home to repair.

choices.label: Walk the route with the volunteer
choices.reply: Otto shows them every turn and carries the damaged lamp himself. At the bend he hands it over.

choices.label: Help repair the lamp before the walk
choices.reply: Otto holds the new glass while the volunteer seats it. They light it together before going out.

pip.title: A kite for two
pip.prompt: Pip has enough paper for one big kite. Kit wants to fly it over the old field, while Aya is watching a nest there.

choices.label: Find a meadow spot with Aya
choices.reply: Pip and Kit try the kite somewhere Aya suggests. It catches the wind without crossing the reeds.

choices.label: Build a smaller kite for the lane
choices.reply: Pip trims the wings and gives Kit the string. They take turns running between the posts.

ren.title: A quiet fishing spot
ren.prompt: Ren is fishing above the old front step Orin described. Orin has stopped on the bank without a rod.

choices.label: Ask Orin where he would rather stand
choices.reply: Ren reels in and follows Orin to a patch of shade. They stay there awhile before Ren casts again.

choices.label: Pack up the rods and sit awhile
choices.reply: Ren sets the rods down. Orin sits beside you and points out where the road turned.

roan.title: The missing verse
roan.prompt: Roan has been asked to sing the old town song. The missing verse names a family he has yet to speak to.

choices.label: Help him ask the family first
choices.reply: Roan leaves the verse for another day. He takes the long way home to stop at their door.

choices.label: Suggest an instrumental ending
choices.reply: Roan plays the last melody without the words. A listener hums it quietly from the back bench.

sable.title: A letter without an address
sable.prompt: Sable has a letter for a former tenant. The council wants the delivery address, and the tenant has asked to keep it private.

choices.label: Offer to carry a sealed reply
choices.reply: Sable keeps the address in their own book and gives you a sealed reply to take back.

choices.label: Ask the tenant how to receive future mail
choices.reply: Sable arranges a pickup at the bakery and writes down only the place the tenant agreed to share.

sana.title: The clinic’s spare bench
sana.prompt: Sana wants to meet families who stopped using the clinic after the flood. A councilor offers to attend the meeting.

choices.label: Offer a private visit first
choices.reply: Sana asks which families would like her to come alone and gives them a choice of days.

choices.label: Set out a bench for an open conversation
choices.reply: Sana puts chairs outside and leaves the clinic door open. She asks the councilor to listen before taking notes.

sol.title: The marked board
sol.prompt: Sol recognizes an old threshold in a pile of usable timber. The family who owned it has been asking what happened to their door.

choices.label: Take the board back to the family
choices.reply: Sol wraps it in a cloth so the worn edge will survive the walk. He lets them unwrap it themselves.

choices.label: Ask whether to reuse it in a shared repair
choices.reply: Sol sets it apart from the pile and waits for the family to decide where they want it to go.

tess.title: The ledger copy
tess.prompt: Tess is preparing a copy of the flood records. A former tenant wants their account preserved but asks to leave their name out of the public copy.

choices.label: Prepare a public and a private copy
choices.reply: Tess puts the tenant’s account in both copies and seals the name with their permission.

choices.label: Ask the tenant to review the wording
choices.reply: Tess sets her pen down and reads the account back. The tenant changes the last sentence before signing it.

vera.title: The second key
vera.prompt: Vera has cut a second key for the floodgate. She is ready to hand it to someone downstream, but nobody has agreed on how both keys should be used.

choices.label: Ask the low bank to write the rule with her
choices.reply: Vera brings the key to the meeting and leaves it on the table while people talk through a drill.

choices.label: Practice a handoff before assigning the key
choices.reply: Vera walks the route with a volunteer and writes down where they lost time. They agree to try again before choosing a keeper.

willa.title: The basket on the shelf
willa.prompt: Willa finds a basket of belongings from the landing that nobody has claimed. The label is still tied to its handle.

choices.label: Help trace the name privately
choices.reply: Willa wraps the basket and asks Sable to make the first contact. She leaves it closed.

choices.label: Ask what the family wants done with it
choices.reply: Willa writes a short note offering delivery or a quiet pickup. She keeps the basket ready by the door.
